text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the end of Ikuno Dictus's gaze was a crane game filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "From that structure... I see. You adjust based on your center of gravity, right?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it too.
Practice makes perfect, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Ikuno Dictus inserted coins into the machine and made several attempts, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph…… Even knowing where to aim,
the crane doesn't move the way I want it to."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: I had no idea you wanted it that badly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... It's for my younger sister and brother.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's been collecting them lately.
She keeps sending me photos of them with Paka Puchi.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If only I could manage to put on
such an angelic smile too, I thought...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's so typical of someone who cherishes her family.
I want to do something for her—
choice_data_list: Then I'll give it a try next time too.
Then I'll give it a try next time too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
